prompt:
Create a square anime music-jacket cover for a gacha-style character MV result. The main subject is a close-up monochrome idol singer, Ninaranai Hikari, a young anime girl with very pale silver-white hair in two thick braids, long messy bangs covering part of her face, one eye winking and the other open with a vivid cyan-blue sparkling iris. She holds a detailed handheld microphone close to her mouth with one hand and touches her ear with the other as if monitoring her voice. Add white and cyan flower hair ornaments on the left side of her head, dangling gem earrings, a small blue pendant necklace, glossy nails, black bow accents, chains, straps, and a stylish black-and-white stage outfit with exposed shoulders. The visual style is high-detail Japanese anime illustration, mostly black, white, and grayscale with electric cyan highlights, glossy metallic reflections, sharp ink textures, halftone noise, paint splatter, cracked-glass shards, diagonal graphic strips, star sparkles, waveform marks, and chaotic album-cover typography.

Canvas and composition: square 1:1 cover art, intense close-up portrait filling most of the frame, face centered slightly above middle, microphone angled from lower right toward the mouth, braids framing the chest, large title typography crossing the lower third. Background is a layered grunge collage of black-and-white shattered glass, abstract paper textures, cyan paint strokes, glitch scratches, diagonal arrows, and music UI decorations.

Text content: Include exactly these main text elements: top left small label “TRACK” above large “01”; beneath it “LIMIT BREAK”, a small cyan waveform, and the small lyric line “I won't be just background noise anymore”; left middle stacked black label with white text “BREAK / THE / SILENCE”; top right boxed rarity badge reading “SUPER” in white and “RARE” in cyan, with a row of six stars beneath it where the last star is cyan; huge lower title text “GLASS SIGNAL” in bold italic cracked display lettering, white with black shadows and cyan internal accents; under the title, small spaced Japanese subtitle text “声 に な ら な い 光”; bottom left mini audio-card reading “WAVEFORM:” with a cyan waveform, “BPM 128” and “KEY Cm”, plus small text “sound becomes light. light becomes me.”; bottom right result panel reading “RESULT”, “SUPER RARE”, “STYLE: MONOCHROME SPARK”, and “TYPE: MUSIC JACKET”.

Constraints: Use exactly one character, one microphone, one boxed rarity badge, one track number block, one break-the-silence label, one mini waveform card, and one result panel. Keep the palette nearly monochrome with cyan as the only strong accent color. Make the typography feel integrated into a premium collectible music jacket, with dramatic contrast and no empty background areas.

promptZh:
为抽卡风格的角色 MV 结果创建一个方形动漫音乐封面。主体是一位特写单色偶像歌手，Ninaranai Hikari，一位年轻的动漫少女，留着非常浅的银白色头发，扎成两条粗辫子，凌乱的长刘海遮住部分脸庞，一只眼睛眨眼，另一只眼睛睁开，露出鲜艳的青蓝色闪亮虹膜。她一只手拿着精致的手持麦克风靠近嘴边，另一只手摸着耳朵，仿佛在监听自己的声音。在她的左侧头部添加白色和青色的花朵发饰、垂坠的宝石耳环、蓝色小吊坠项链、光泽美甲、黑色蝴蝶结装饰、链条、绑带，以及一套时尚的露肩黑白舞台装。视觉风格为高细节的日本动漫插画，以黑、白、灰度为主，辅以电光青色高光、光泽金属反射、锐利的墨水质感、半色调噪点、油漆飞溅、碎玻璃碎片、对角线图形条、星光闪烁、波形标记以及混乱的专辑封面排版。

画布与构图：方形 1:1 封面艺术，强烈的特写肖像占据画面大部分，脸部位于中心偏上方，麦克风从右下方指向嘴部，辫子环绕胸前，大型标题排版横跨下三分之一处。背景是分层的垃圾风格拼贴画，包含黑白碎玻璃、抽象纸张纹理、青色笔触、故障划痕、对角线箭头和音乐 UI 装饰。

文本内容：包含以下主要文本元素：左上角小标签“TRACK”位于大号“01”上方；下方为“LIMIT BREAK”、一个小型青色波形以及小行歌词“I won't be just background noise anymore”；左侧中间堆叠的黑色标签，带有白色文字“BREAK / THE / SILENCE”；右上角带框的稀有度徽章，白色文字“SUPER”和青色文字“RARE”，下方有一排六颗星，最后一颗星为青色；底部巨大的标题文字“GLASS SIGNAL”，采用粗体斜体裂纹显示字体，白色带有黑色阴影和青色内部点缀；标题下方是小型间距的日语副标题“声 に な ら な い 光”；左下角迷你音频卡片显示“WAVEFORM:”，带有青色波形、“BPM 128”和“KEY Cm”，以及小字“sound becomes light. light becomes me.”；右下角结果面板显示“RESULT”、“SUPER RARE”、“STYLE: MONOCHROME SPARK”和“TYPE: MUSIC JACKET”。

约束：仅使用一个角色、一个麦克风、一个带框稀有度徽章、一个曲目编号块、一个“打破沉默”标签、一个迷你波形卡片和一个结果面板。调色板保持近乎单色，仅以青色作为强烈的强调色。确保排版与高级收藏级音乐封面融为一体，具有强烈的对比度，且背景无留白。
